mentions.name: Book of Revenue
mentions.description: Open-source, self-hosted revenue recognition and analytics tool for Stripe, described as the first open-source revenue analytics option for Stripe. Built by a former Stripe engineer who worked on revenue recognition and analytics there.
mentions.problem: There was no open-source revenue recognition and analytics tool for Stripe, and revenue is often conflated with MRR or payments rather than understood on its own terms.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an open-source, self-hosted revenue recognition and analytics for Stripe.

Here: https://bookofrevenue.com
mentions.author: tanin
